def is_blank(value):
    return value is None or value == ""

def letters_for_index(n):
    """1 -> a, 26 -> z, 27 -> aa, 28 -> ab, etc."""
    result = []
    while n > 0:
        n -= 1
        result.append(chr(ord("a") + (n % 26)))
        n //= 26
    return "".join(reversed(result))

def anchor_to_text(value):
    """Convert an existing URN anchor to the text prefix used for inserted-row URNs."""
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, float) and math.isfinite(value) and value.is_integer():
        return str(int(value))
    return str(value)

ws = wb["Sheet1"]

blank_streak = 0

    data_cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=2)
